plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked extraction-temperature and parasite-clearance chart from Tu Youyou (1971–1972 & 2011 Nature Medicine 17: 1217–1220) compares traditional boiling-water/ethanol extraction of Artemisia annua at 80–100 °C (12% to 40% malaria inhibition, heat-destroying the peroxide bridge) against Tu Youyou's 4 October 1971 Sample #191 cold diethyl-ether extraction at 35 °C (100% parasite clearance in rodent and monkey malaria).

teach_overlay.scale: lowering the extraction heat from boiling water at one hundred degrees Celsius to gentle ether at thirty-five degrees jumped the cure rate from twelve per cent to a complete one hundred per cent
